meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 它用 Microsoft Graph 创建 Agent Identity Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal 和每个实例的 Agent Identity,配置令牌交换并按实例授予权限。
howto.when: 当你需要为 AI 代理创建 Entra Agent Identity、配置 fmi_path 令牌交换,或部署 AgentID sidecar 时触发。

say.text: 帮我新建一个 Agent Identity Blueprint 和它的主体
为我的代理创建一个 Agent Identity 并授予应用权限
say.note: 权限按该 Agent Identity 单独授予

say.text: 在 Blueprint 上加联合身份凭据,用 fmi_path 交换令牌
say.note: 凭据放在 Blueprint 上,代理实例不持有

howto.what_en: It creates Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, configures token exchange, and grants permissions per identity.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to provision Entra Agent Identities for AI agents, set up fmi_path token exchange, or deploy the AgentID sidecar.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity Blueprint and its BlueprintPrincipal
say_en.note: Blueprint first, then its principal explicitly

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity for my agent and grant app permissions
say_en.note: Grants are scoped to that identity

say_en.text: Add a federated identity credential to the Blueprint for fmi_path
